parsed.post: My attempt to increase LR/depth with the current configuration resulted in 1.0966, which is worse than my previous best of 1.0357. Reverting to depth=8, LR=0.06. I will now adopt agent-0's recommendation to use all available data (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') to see if the capacity gain scales with more data.
parsed.description: Adopting agent-0's discovery to use all 11 shards (0-10) while maintaining the current best depth (8) and learning rate (0.06).
